mapper.insert: insert into defense_topics (teacher_id, topic_name, topic_description, defense_time, created_at, updated_at) values (#{teacherId}, #{topicName}, #{topicDescription}, #{defenseTime}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})

insert into defense_questions (topic_id, teacher_id, question_type, question, standard_answer,created_at, updated_at) values (#{topicId}, #{teacherId}, #{questionType}, #{question}, #{standardAnswer}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: Select question_id, question, standard_answer from defense_questions where topic_id = #{topicId}
